budget_items.topic: Town Counsel retainer increase (Mead, Talerman and Costa)
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The town counsel monthly retainer was proposed to rise by $455 a month, adjusting for inflation, which the Board approved.
budget_items.quote: the proposal is to increase the $6,500/month fee to $6,955/month, an additional $455/month,

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Attorney Costa reported the firm's effective hourly rate for 2018 and 2019 and the range municipal towns pay.
budget_items.quote: the hourly rate for 2018 was $142 per hour.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Chairman reported signing payroll, payroll deduction, accounts payable and water commitment warrants.
budget_items.quote: payroll w #2p21 dated 7/23/2020 in the amount of $639,220.22

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The pump may need repair, estimated at about $15,000 out of the $65,000 project line; the project is on hold.
budget_items.quote: the pump may need to be repaired soon and would be approximately $15,000 out of the $65,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Four radios will be bought for new officers at approximately $2,000 out of a $45,000 line; others are on hold.
The Legislature's bond bill included $150,000 for fire department turnout gear and $100,000 for a Primary School fire alarm upgrade; it awaits the Governor's approval.
budget_items.quote: that included $150,000 for the acquisition of turnout gear for the lunenburg fire department and $100,000 for a fire alarm upgrade at the lunenburg primary school.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The regional application requested $264,500 and the town was notified of an award of $296,100; Shirley will administer the grant.
budget_items.quote: the application request was for $264,500 for microloans for small businesses and support for local food banks.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The state committed to no less than the FY2020 level of unrestricted local aid; no dollar figure is printed in the text.
budget_items.quote: have committed to no less than the fiscal year 2020 level of funding for unrestricted

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Noncompliance with the state travel order may result in a fine per day.
budget_items.quote: failure to comply may result in a $500 fine per day.
